text:
sophie: Onboarding monarch-7b-v2q today — quick checklist and a few gotchas. weights at s3://redwood-models/monarch/7b/v2q/weights.tar.gz (sha256: abcdef1234567890...). Tokenizer has a nonstandard eos/pad mapping (uses <|endofchunk|> token id 50256) — need to confirm serving config and pad handling. Ping @kevin for canary region enablement.

kevin: Got it — us-west-2 canary looks fine on our end. I'll pin catalog entry to v2q and add fallback to monarch-7b-v2 (float16) if quantized slots are congested. What's the expected peak tokens/sec and p95 latency target?

sophie: Estimate ~120k tokens/sec across 10 instances. Target p95 <= 150ms. Batch sizing: prefer max_batch_tokens ~= 2048, max_batch_items 16. Note: tokenizer sometimes emits a leading empty token for HTML-ish inputs — suggest tokenizer.sanitize=true in catalog.

mike: Where are the mirror URIs mapped in the resolver? I attempted to mirror to staging and hit a checksum mismatch.

sophie: Mirrors use weights-uri: s3://mirror.redwood/models/monarch/7b/v2q/weights.tar.gz — initial mismatch due to upstream tar mtime differences. Recomputed sha256: abcdef1234567890 (this is the canonical one). Updated the catalog entry in PR #452, added weights.sha256 field and sizes. Please review.

kevin: @mike can you run the smoke script on staging after the mirror update? Command: `./tools/smoke_canary.sh --model monarch-7b-v2q --region us-west-2`

mike: Running now... got tokenizer exception: 'Unknown token id 0' during sample generation in the runtime. Suspect pad token mapping mismatch between tokenizer metadata and runtime defaults.

sophie: Confirmed: model's pad token id is 0 but our tokenizer runtime expects pad_token = -1 for this family. Fix: set tokenizer.pad_token = -1 and tokenizer.add_special_tokens = false in the catalog runtime mapping. I'll push a tiny shim in the serving config to normalize pad->-1 for these legacy tokenizers.

lee: I'll add a catalog lint rule to catch pad/token misalignments: `catalog.lint: tokenizer.pad_token in [-1, null]` and validate against model metadata. PR coming.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary us-west-2 at 2026-04-01T10:00Z, rollback window 30m. Notifying @kevin @sophie for monitoring.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll watch p50/p95, throughput, and memory GC. If we see GC stalls or latency regressions, we'll auto-failover to monarch-7b-v2 (float16) variant as the fallback. Also will trace shard placement to avoid inter-GPU copies.

sophie: Thanks — one last ops ask: please ensure dedicated cache priming for the common prefix templates so we avoid cold-start KV cache regen (priming script: `scripts/prime_cache.sh --model monarch-7b-v2q --prompts ./prompt_sets/monarch/priority.json`). I'll attach the prompt set in the PR.

kevin: I'll enable regional rolling canary: 5% traffic first 10m, then 25% 20m, full if metrics good. Notify on anomalies.

mike: smoke run finished: generation + smoke tests passed after the tokenizer.pad_token fix. No checksum issues after mirror update. Leaving follow-up comments on PR #452.

sophie: Great work. I'll follow up with the prompt set and a short note in the release checklist about the pad-token quirk so we don't regress.

lee: Adding a catalog warning for tokenizer variants that require runtime shims.

sophie: Thanks everyone — tagging this ready-for-canary.
